rules.name: Moderate Cross-Bureau Balance Mismatch
rules.description: Balances for the same clustered tradeline differ beyond moderate tolerance thresholds but not severe.
rules.logicSummary: Cluster tradelines; if max-min balance difference exceeds moderate thresholds but is below severe thresholds, flag.

rules.name: Severe Cross-Bureau Balance Mismatch
rules.description: Balances for the same clustered tradeline differ beyond severe tolerance thresholds.
rules.logicSummary: Cluster tradelines; if max-min balance difference exceeds severe thresholds, flag.

rules.name: Past-Due on Zero-Balance Tradeline
rules.description: Tradeline shows a past-due amount with a zero balance.
rules.logicSummary: If balance is 0 but pastDueAmount > 0, flag.

rules.name: Balance Exceeds High Credit Limit
rules.description: Tradeline balance exceeds the reported high credit limit.

rules.name: Transferred or Sold with Non-Zero Balance
rules.description: Tradeline is transferred/sold but still shows a non-zero balance.
rules.logicSummary: If status is Transferred/Sold and balance > 0, flag.

rules.name: Transferred or Sold but Payment History Continues
rules.description: Tradeline is transferred/sold but continues to show payment history afterward.
rules.logicSummary: If status is Transferred/Sold and paymentHistory exists, flag.

rules.name: Closed or Paid Tradeline with Past-Due Amount
rules.description: Tradeline is closed/paid but still shows a past-due amount.
rules.logicSummary: If status is Closed/Paid and pastDueAmount > 0, flag.

rules.name: Status Conflicts with Payment History
rules.description: Status suggests good standing but payment history shows delinquencies.
rules.logicSummary: If status is Open/good but paymentHistory has late/CO codes, flag.

rules.name: Non-Bankruptcy Derogatory Older than 7 Years
rules.description: Non-BK derogatory tradeline/collection appears older than 7-year obsolescence window.
rules.logicSummary: If DOFD -> today > 7 years + buffer, flag as obsolete derogatory.

rules.name: Bankruptcy Older than 10 Years
rules.description: Bankruptcy public record appears older than 10-year window.
rules.logicSummary: If BK filedDate -> today > 10 years + buffer, flag as obsolete bankruptcy.

rules.name: Multiple Collections for Same Debt
rules.description: More than one collection appears to represent the same underlying debt.
rules.logicSummary: Group by collectorName + originalCreditorName; if more than one entry, flag.

rules.name: Zero-Balance Collection Still Open
rules.description: Collection has zero balance but is still reported as open.
rules.logicSummary: If balance = 0 and status = Open, flag.

rules.name: Public Record in State Not in Address History
rules.description: Public record is in a state not present in consumer's address history.
rules.logicSummary: Compare courtName to consumer states; if no match, flag.
